{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
# This is required regardless of biomarker_baseline value, as per the data dictionary
df_dedup = df.sort_values(by="sample_seq", ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset="patient_id", keep="first")

# Final count of unique patients (all enrolled patients)
n_patients = len(df_dedup)
print(n_patients)"}
